name: AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate

fee.note: USD list price; taxes may apply. AWS charges set local-currency prices in countries that use the euro (€128), Australian dollar (A$224), Japanese yen (¥20,000), Korean won, Chinese yuan and Indian rupee (vouchers only), updated at least once a year. After you earn one AWS Certification, the next exam is 50% off.

exam.format: 65 multiple choice and multiple response questions, 130 minutes, at a Pearson VUE test center or online proctored. AWS recommends the equivalent of 2–3 years in data engineering and at least 1–2 years of hands-on experience with AWS services.

scope: Building and running data pipelines on AWS: ingestion, transformation and orchestration, choosing data stores and modeling and cataloging data, operating and monitoring pipelines and data quality, and data security, privacy and governance.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.

prep.title: AWS Skill Builder: DEA-C01 exam prep plan
prep.note: The 4-step plan linked from the certification page. The Official Practice Question Set and the Exam Prep course are free; the Official Practice Exam needs a Skill Builder subscription.

domains_note: Weights from the AWS Certification Exam Guide (DEA-C01, guide version 1.1, December 12, 2025), the guide linked from the live certification page. Read 2026-11-17.
